input.prompt: Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. Outdoor wedding reception: long candlelit dinner tables under hanging white flower installations and trees, the same venue throughout. The sun has just set: the deep orange sunset glow behind the trees fades into a soft pale peach afterglow and the sky above softens. The natural light changes slowly and continuously from the first frame to the last. A gentle breeze slightly pushes the leaves and the hanging flowers so they sway softly, and the candle flames flicker and lean in the same light wind. Photorealistic, natural light, identical composition and objects throughout.
